title: Internal admin console (minimal web UI)
goal: Provide a minimal internal web console over the admin API so support staff can look up accounts and workspaces, inspect entitlements, manage flags and incidents, without any content access.
scope_in: Vite + React single-page app in `apps/admin/`, built to static files served only on the private network, with login using the staff token flow and a role-aware UI.
Pages: search/lookup by id or email, user detail, workspace detail (members, subscription, entitlements, usage), session metadata, flags editor, incident editor, staff audit view.
Mandatory reason dialog (10-500 chars) and optional ticket id attached as `X-Admin-Reason`/`X-Admin-Ticket` on every request; destructive actions require typing the target id.
Typed API client built on the DTOs exported by the admin API (type-only imports), with problem+json error handling.
Strict CSP, no third-party scripts or fonts, tokens kept in memory only, automatic sign-out after 15 min idle.
Accessibility basics (keyboard navigation, labels) and dark/light via CSS variables.
scope_out: Any new backend endpoint (B087 owns the API); gaps are filed against B087.
Customer-facing web app (client plan; not part of this repo).
Content viewing of any session or history.
build_against: A mock admin API server (MSW) generated from the DTO types of B087, run in unit tests; a Playwright smoke run against the real admin API in the stage-like compose stack only if available, otherwise MSW.
interfaces: Build output `apps/admin/dist/` (static) and dev command `pnpm --filter @centcom/admin dev`; env `VITE_ADMIN_API_BASE`.
acceptance: Every request issued by the app carries `X-Admin-Reason`; a network-level test asserts no request leaves without it, and cancelling the reason dialog sends nothing.

A `support_ro` user sees no write buttons and the app never calls a write route (assert via MSW request log); a `support_rw` user sees them; role comes from the API response, not from client-side token parsing alone.

The built `index.html` has a CSP of `default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' <admin api origin>; frame-ancestors 'none'` and loads zero third-party origins (asserted by scanning dist).
Access token never appears in `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, cookies, URLs or console output; after 15 min idle (fake timers) the app clears it and shows the sign-in screen.
Destructive actions (revoke tokens, disable user, end session) require typing the exact target id; a wrong value keeps the button disabled.
Rendering a server value containing `<script>` or HTML in any text field shows it as text (no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` in the codebase, lint rule enforced).
Initial JS bundle <= 250 KiB gzip; Lighthouse accessibility score >= 90 on the lookup and workspace pages.
tests: component tests for every page with MSW fixtures (Vitest + Testing Library).
unit: API client error mapping from problem+json; reason header injection.
security test: CSP and bundle origin scan; XSS rendering test.
Playwright smoke: login -> lookup -> workspace detail -> set flag (against MSW or stage-like stack).
a11y test with axe on main pages.
guardrails: MUST NOT store tokens in browser storage or cookies and MUST NOT log tokens or personal data to the console.
MUST NOT include any code path that displays or requests session content, history, keys or message text.
MUST NOT call any host other than the configured admin API; no analytics, no CDN assets.
MUST NOT be deployed to a public hostname; the build output is served only inside the private network (documented in the README).
MUST treat all API strings as untrusted text.
failure_modes: Admin API returns 401/403 -> app clears the token and shows a sign-in or 'not permitted' page without leaking details.
API 5xx or network failure -> inline error with request id, no automatic retry of write actions.
Role downgrade while open -> next API response 403 triggers a role refresh and hides controls.
notes: Technology choice (Vite + React) is the same family as the other web code in the project but this app is independent and shares no packages with any client repo. Depends only on B087's DTO types; if B087 changes a route the MSW fixtures must be updated. `implements` is empty because no wire contract is realised.
